options.name: HUD SKIN
options.description: Choose the visual skin for the HUD.

options.name: SCORE DISPLAY
options.description: Show your current score.

options.name: MISSES DISPLAY
options.description: Show a counter for how many notes you've missed.

options.name: RANK DISPLAY
options.description: Show your current Rank (P, E, G) based on performance.

options.name: COMBO TIER DISPLAY
options.description: Show your Combo Status (SFC, GFC, FC, Clear).

options.name: TIME BAR
options.description: Show a bar indicating progress.

options.name: SONG TIME TEXT
options.description: Show a digital timer counting down the song.

options.name: BREAK BAR
options.description: Show a specific timer during long breaks in the song.

options.name: SONG TITLE DISPLAY
options.description: Show the name of the song on the HUD.

options.name: DIFFICULTY DISPLAY
options.description: Show the difficulty level on the HUD.

options.name: COLORED HEALTH BAR
options.description: Changes the health bar colors to match the character icons.

options.name: BREAK BAR STYLE
options.description: The visual style of the break bar.

options.name: NIGHT MODE
options.description: Dims the game screen to reduce eye strain.

options.name: NIGHT FILTER OPACITY
options.description: How dark the night mode filter should be.

options.name: NIGHT MODE AUTO START
options.description: When set to Auto, night mode activates at this start time.

options.name: NIGHT MODE AUTO END
options.description: When set to Auto, night mode turns off at this end time.

options.name: SCORE BOP ANIMATION
options.description: Makes the score text bop when hitting notes.

options.name: MIDDLESCROLL
options.description: Moves your notes to the center of the screen for better focus.

options.name: GHOSTTAPPING
options.description: Press keys anytime without penalty. You won't miss if there's no note.

options.name: GHOSTSING
options.description: Your character will play singing animations when you press empty keys.

options.name: RESUME COUNTDOWN
options.description: Adds a 'Ready, Set, Go!' countdown when you unpause the game.

options.name: ACCURACY CALCULATION
options.description: How accuracy is calculated. 'Ascending' starts at 0% and climbs up.

options.name: HITSOUND MODE
options.description: Plays a sound. On Note Hit triggers only when hitting notes, Anytime triggers on any tap.

options.name: HITSOUND VOLUME
options.description: Adjust the volume of the hitsound.

options.name: JUDGEMENT COUNTER
options.description: Shows a counter for Sicks, Goods, Bads, etc. Choose where to place it.

options.name: INCOMING NOTE FADE
options.description: Lanes will glow when a note is approaching (up to 4 seconds ahead).

options.name: HIDE OPPONENT NOTES
options.description: Hides the opponent's notes completely. Only active when Middle Scroll is Off.

options.name: OPPONENT OPACITY
options.description: Adjust the transparency of the opponent's notes.

options.name: OPP STRUMLINE BG
options.description: Show the dark background behind the opponent's notes. (Disabled on Middle Scroll)

options.name: OPPONENT POS
options.description: Where to put the opponent's notes when Middle Scroll is ON.

options.name: CUSTOM DISCORD RPC
options.description: Customize your Discord Rich Presence layout to show your live stats to your friends.

options.name: PC/HITBOX MODE
options.description: Enable if using a Hitbox or Keyboard on mobile. Unlocks PC settings.

options.name: SHOW OPPONENT NOTES ON ARROWS
options.description: Forces the opponent's notes to appear and scroll in the background during mobile Arrows gameplay.

options.name: HEALTH BAR POSITION
options.description: Choose where the health bar is placed horizontally on the screen.

options.name: TIME BAR POSITION
options.description: Choose where the Song Progress Bar is placed on screen.

options.name: BREAK BAR POSITION
options.description: Where to place the break bar.

options.name: HEALTH ICON POSITIONS
options.description: Choose where the character icons are placed on the health bar.

options.name: SCORE TEXT POSITION
options.description: Choose where the score text is placed relative to the health bar.

options.name: SONG INFO POSITION
options.description: Where to show the Song Name and Difficulty.

options.name: INTRO TEXT POSITION
options.description: Where the intro text appears on screen.

options.name: SUBTITLES POSITION
options.description: Where to display subtitles.

options.name: MAIN HUD FONT
options.description: Choose the font for the HUD.

options.name: PIXEL STAGE FONT
options.description: Choose the font for pixel stages.

options.name: INTRO TITLE FONT
options.description: Choose the font for the intro title.

options.name: INTRO ARTIST FONT
options.description: Choose the font for the intro artist.

options.name: SONG INTRO TEXT
options.description: Displays the song title and artist when the song starts.

options.name: SONG ALBUM COVER
options.description: Displays the song's album cover art alongside the intro text.

options.name: SUBTITLES ANIMATION
options.description: How subtitles appear on screen.

options.name: SMART KARAOKE MODE
options.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Syncs the text letter by letter like singing.

options.name: LOW DETAIL OPTIONS MENU
options.description: Disables menu animations and tweens for better performance on low-end devices.

options.name: SMOOTH NUMBER ANIMATIONS
options.description: Makes the score and accuracy numbers scroll smoothly.
